programmes_confirmed.name: Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA)
programmes_confirmed.exam_schedule: Session-based exams in June and December; on-demand CBEs run year-round.

programmes_confirmed.name: Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA)
programmes_confirmed.exam_schedule: On-demand CBEs; case studies in November; retakes in February, May, and August.

programmes_confirmed.name: Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy (CIPFA)
levels: Certificate in Municipal Finance and Accounting

requirements: 4 credits including Mathematics or English or Accounting.
Or comparable qualifications assessed by ECOL/MOET.
Or A-Level with Mathematics and English pass plus 3 years accounting work experience.
Must be employed by the Government of Lesotho for at least 2 years in accounts/finance.

progression_rules: Missing 2 consecutive weeks without reason results in expulsion from class.
registration_rules: Self-sponsored students pay 50% upfront and the balance within 4 months.

fees_policy.exact_amounts_source: Application and acceptance fees confirmed manually by project owner; module, subscription, registration, and exam fee amounts still require CAS Accounts Office or a fee schedule.
